description: Connect this agent to a human's webhooks.cc account, for the full tool set (mock responses, signatures, email, teams) and to keep the sandbox endpoints. Returns a link and a 6-digit code: show both to the human, who signs in or signs up with that email and enters the code. Then call wait_for_connection. Calling again gives a new code.

email.description: The email the human signs in to webhooks.cc with (their GitHub or Google primary email if they sign in that way); only someone signed in as it can connect

name: connect_account
